column1: # Косвенная речь, относительные и обстоятельственные придаточные.

column2: He said he had finished the work.
She said she would come tomorrow.
He asked where I lived.
She wondered if he was ready.
He said hello and left.
She asked a question.
The book that changed my life was cheap.
The man who I saw yesterday is my neighbor.
The author whose book won the prize is young.
My brother, who lives in Rome, is a doctor.

column1: # Союз при глаголе речи и указательное местоимение — не relative.

column2: He said that he came late.
That book was good.
He stood up in order to see better.
We whispered so that the baby would not wake.
The game was canceled because of the rain.
She left early because she was tired.
Due to the storm, all flights were canceled.
Although it rained, we went out.
Whereas most people agreed, he refused.
As a child, he lived in Rome.
